record.question: Which of the following is the correct definition of Internal Evaluation?
options: All types of evaluation done inside the school
All evaluations which come under the purview of the school
Evaluation in which the evaluator is the one who teaches the subject
Evaluation conducted by the same school, but marked by the persons other than the ones who teach the students
record.explanation: Internal evaluation is evaluation by the teacher who teaches the subject.
